families.name: Security
families.description: Deterministic blocks on destructive commands, sensitive paths and file placement.

gates.description: Denies git reset --hard, rm -rf, force push, taskkill by image, and unauthorized remote publish.

params.name: denyPatterns
params.description: Regex sources of destructive commands to deny. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: rmRfProtectedAreas
params.description: Paths that rm -rf may not target (e.g. /, *, src, tests).

params.name: embeddedInterpreterEnabled
params.description: Whether to block node/python -e that does raw file ops. Off by default.

gates.description: Denies writes to .env, lockfiles and the harness itself.

params.name: protectedPaths
params.description: Path fragments no write or mutating command may target.

params.name: mutatingCommands
params.description: Shell command names treated as mutating (touch, rm, cp, mv, sed -i, tee, chmod...).

gates.description: Denies new root-level files/folders outside the project's whitelist.

params.name: rootFilesWhitelist
params.description: Root-level file names allowed to be created.

params.name: rootFoldersWhitelist
params.description: Root-level folder names allowed to be created.

gates.description: Denies sleep, tail -f, polling loops and foreground servers.

params.name: blockingPatterns
params.description: Regex sources of blocking/waiting forms to deny.

params.name: waitJustifiedMarker
params.description: Comment marker that authorizes a justified wait as an escape hatch.

families.name: Delegation
families.description: Requirements on the brief of a subagent delegation.

gates.description: Requires goal, steps and done-when criteria in the prompt.

params.name: minBriefLength
params.description: Minimum brief length before it is considered complete.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the brief requirement (read-only work).

gates.description: Requires IN SCOPE / OUT OF SCOPE / EDGE CASES sections.

params.name: highImpactPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for high-impact work whose scope declaration is enforced.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the scope-list requirement.

gates.description: Requires LEVEL: QUESTION|MICRO|STANDARD|HIGH-RISK consistent with the request.

params.name: highImpactPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for high-impact signals that demand a declared level.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the risk-level requirement.

gates.description: Cuts the same delegation retried without substantial changes.

params.name: retryThreshold
params.description: Identical consecutive retries before the delegation is cut.

params.name: similarityThreshold
params.description: Dice similarity (0-1) above which two prompts count as the same.

gates.description: Warns when the brief relies on the subagent remembering the conversation.

params.name: memoryDependencyPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for phrases that lean on the subagent's memory.

families.name: Spec-driven flow
families.description: Only meaningful when the project adopted spec-driven development (feature list, specs).

gates.description: Single in_progress; done requires asserts and review.

params.name: catalogFileName
params.description: Name of the feature catalog file (default feature_list.json).

params.name: maxInProgress
params.description: Maximum features allowed in_progress at once.

gates.description: Non-empty requirements/design/tasks before in_progress.

params.name: catalogLocations
params.description: Paths searched for the feature catalog.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the spec requirement.

gates.description: Definition, writing, validation, QA and closure declared before building.

params.name: builderSubagents
params.description: Subagent types that count as builders (subject to the pipeline).

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the pipeline requirement.

gates.description: Requires an active task with a contract before implementing.

params.name: activePointerPath
params.description: Path to the active-pipeline pointer file.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the live-task requirement.

gates.description: Requires a test matrix (types the requirement makes mandatory) in the brief.

params.name: e2eSignals
params.description: Regex sources that make an E2E row mandatory (money, auth, data...).

params.name: visualSignals
params.description: Regex sources that make a visual/QA row mandatory (UI signals).

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the test-matrix requirement.

families.name: Quality and hygiene
families.description: Dependencies, diagnosis before patching, assumptions and language.

gates.description: A new direct dependency requires a current skill.

params.name: depsWithoutOwnApi
params.description: Dependencies exempt because they have no API of their own.

params.name: projectSkillsDir
params.description: Directory where the project's skills live.

gates.description: Requires an origin-to-symptom diagnosis before a patch.

params.name: patchMarkerPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for temporary-patch markers that require a diagnosis.

gates.description: Before a new script/gate, state that no existing tool covers it.

params.name: executableExtensions
params.description: File extensions treated as executable tools.

params.name: toolFolders
params.description: Folders where a new tool triggers the audit requirement.

gates.description: Flags unverified assumptions in briefs and code.

params.name: conjecturePatterns
params.description: Regex sources for conjecture phrases (I assume, probably, should be...).

gates.description: Loads gates declared by the project's rules/*.mjs and skills/*/gate.mjs.

params.name: rulesDir
params.description: Directory scanned for rule gate modules.

params.name: gateFileNames
params.description: File names recognized as a skill/rule gate.

gates.description: A second occurrence of a defect class requires its deterministic block.

params.name: thresholdAppearances
params.description: Appearances of a defect class before its block is required.

gates.description: Warns when a test is created after its paired implementation.

params.name: implementationExtensions
params.description: Source extensions whose paired test is checked.

gates.description: Never re-ask what the user already answered.

params.name: overlapThreshold
params.description: Word-overlap ratio (0-1) above which a question counts as a re-ask.

gates.description: Warns on voseo or regional lexicon in written text.

params.name: regionalMarkers
params.description: Regional words to warn about. Replaces the built-in list.

gates.description: Warns when timeouts/retries change without evidence.

params.name: timeoutPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for timeout/deadline/retry keys to watch.

families.name: Tool discovery
families.description: Do not reinvent the wheel: consult a per-project tool map before building.

gates.description: Consults the project tool map; blocks building a tool absent from it without an audit.

params.name: toolMapFile
params.description: Path to the per-project tool map (default .ai/tool-map.json).

gates.description: Records discovered tools into the per-project map so exploration is not repeated.

params.name: toolMapFile
params.description: Path to the per-project tool map (default .ai/tool-map.json).

families.name: Forge pipeline
families.description: Enforce the forge pipeline: a project that adopted forge routes every change through it.

gates.description: In a forge-adopted project, denies edits/commands unless an active forge run exists for it.

params.name: forgeDbPath
params.description: Path to forge's global SQLite DB (default ~/.forge/forge-mcp.db).

families.name: Autonomy
families.description: Autonomous mode: block the question popup so an unattended run decides instead of asking.

gates.description: When autonomous mode is on, denies AskUserQuestion so the assistant decides instead of asking.

families.name: Session start
families.description: SessionStart hooks: environment validation and project sync.

gates.description: Runs the environment validator and only speaks on failure.
In a project that never answered, makes the assistant ask what to adopt.
Warns when a registered hook is missing or a script is orphaned.
